clauses.requirement: Stop lamps (S1, S2, S3, S4, MS) per UN R148 para 5.5.5: no additional specific requirements apply beyond those in the regulation.
Stop lamps (S1, S2, S3, S4, MS) per UN R148 para 5.5.6: failure provisions shall comply with paragraph 4.6.
Stop lamps (S1, S2, S3, S4, MS) per UN R148 para 5.5.7: the colour of light emitted shall be red.

If direction indicator lamps (categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 5, 6, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c, 12) are fitted, they shall comply with the specific technical requirements of UN R148 para 5.6; this function is not listed for the rear lamp.

If direction indicator lamps are fitted, the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet Table 8, with minimum luminous intensities fulfilled (a) for categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12 in the reference axis, or (b) for categories 5 and 6 in direction A according to Annex 2.

If direction indicator lamps are fitted, luminous intensities shall comply with Table 8 per category: minimum, maximum (single lamp, and lamp marked D where applicable), standard light distribution and angles of geometric visibility. Example values: cat. 1 min 1.75E2 cd, max 1.20E3 cd (single), 6.00E2 cd (marked D); 1a 2.50E2; 1b 4.00E2; 2a steady 5.0E1/5.00E2; 2b variable 5.0E1/1.00E3 with day/night values; 5 6E-1 min; 6 5.0E1 min; 11 9.0E1; 11a 1.75E2; 11b 2.50E2; 11c 4.00E2; 12 5.0E1, per Table 8.
If side marker lamps (SM1, SM2) are fitted, per UN R148 para 5.7.5 no additional specific requirements apply.
If side marker lamps (SM1, SM2) are fitted, per UN R148 para 5.7.6 failure provisions shall comply with paragraph 4.6.
